title: InferenceContract
description: Request and response contract for voice-based decision-support inference. Results are indicators for clinical decision support only — never autonomous diagnoses. A human clinician must interpret all results.

InferenceRequest.description: Request payload for a voice-based inference call.

request_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for this inference request. UUID v4 format.

session_id.description: Pseudonymous session identifier. Same format as voice-feature-schema.json.

model_version.description: SemVer version of the model to use for inference. Must match a deployed model version.

task.description: The inference task identifier. Must be a supported task registered for the requested model version.

feature_set_id.description: Feature set identifier, must match what the requested model version expects.

extraction_version.description: Extraction pipeline version that produced the features.

features.description: Acoustic feature map. Must conform to what the requested model_version and feature_set_id expect.

InferenceResponse.description: Response payload from a voice-based inference call.

request_id.description: Echo of the request_id for idempotency verification.

result_status.description: Status of the inference computation. LOW_CONFIDENCE means a result was produced but uncertainty is high.

result_is_not_a_diagnosis.description: Always true. This field is a machine-readable assertion that this result is a decision-support indicator, not a clinical diagnosis. Must never be false or omitted.

indicator.description: The inference output. Present only when result_status is SUCCESS or LOW_CONFIDENCE. Null otherwise.

label.description: The indicator label produced by the model. This is a research indicator, not a clinical diagnosis.

confidence.description: Model confidence score in [0, 1]. Null if the model does not produce calibrated probabilities.

uncertainty_note.description: Human-readable note about uncertainty or confidence limitations for this result.

limitations.description: One or more documented limitations of this model and result. Must not be empty. Omitting limitations is not permitted.
examples: This model has not been validated in a prospective clinical study.
Performance may vary across languages and recording conditions not represented in the training data.
Results must be reviewed by a qualified clinician before any clinical decision is made.

error.description: Error details. Present only when result_status is ERROR.

message.description: Error message. Must not include participant data or internal stack traces.

responded_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the response was generated.

x-changelog.changes: Initial contract version. Defines WELLNESS_SCREENING, SPEECH_QUALITY_ASSESSMENT, and LANGUAGE_IDENTIFICATION tasks.

x-governance.note: No consuming application may present an inference result as a clinical diagnosis. The limitations array must be surfaced to any human reviewer.
